@@ -103,6 +103,29 @@ jobs:
       - name: Run notes governance lane

+  coverage-vitest:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs:
+      - test-fast
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_MIN_VERSION }}
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Run Vitest coverage lane
+        run: bun run ci:test:coverage
+
+      - name: Append coverage summary to workflow summary
+        if: always()
+        run: cat .ci/coverage-summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+

     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
